description: The Shine Shark 6-in-1 Car Wash Kit transforms your vehicle cleaning routine into a professional-grade experience right at home. This comprehensive car cleaning solution brings together all the essential tools you need for a thorough and safe wash. At the heart of the kit is the 2-litre snow foam sprayer that generates thick, luxurious foam to gently lift and loosen dirt, grime, and contaminants from your vehicle's surface before you even touch it. The included premium shampoo works in harmony with the sprayer to create that perfect foam consistency. The ultra-soft 2400 GSM microfiber wash mitt glides across paintwork, safely capturing dirt particles without scratching or marring delicate surfaces. For those hard-to-clean areas, the specialised tyre cleaning brush tackles stubborn brake dust and road grime from tyres and wheel surfaces with ease. Once your vehicle is sparkling clean, the highly absorbent 1200 GSM microfiber drying towel quickly wicks away water, whilst the additional microfiber cloth ensures a flawless, streak-free finish. Whether you're a dedicated car enthusiast or simply want to keep your vehicle looking its best, this complete kit provides everything needed for salon-quality results at home.
